notes_for_editor: County conflict to review: tnlandforms places the tower in Jefferson County (33.09640, -82.43530), while the FFLA report mentions only a GDOT project in Glascock County, not the tower's location. The Glascock County label in the report is for the project, so the story keeps Jefferson per the list. Name is a question-marked guess on the list; the FFLA report uses 'the Glascock tower'. Story is 133 words after the fact-check edits, above the 120-word floor. Best lead: the GDOT project's engineering firm (cultural resource reports often describe nearby structures) and the Georgia Forestry Commission, which historically ran Georgia's towers.
